verdict: Yes. D'chica pitched innerwear designed for teenage girls on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. It's a clear gap: most brands design for adults, and mothers are looking for comfortable, age-appropriate options. Trust and education matter as much as product.
angle: Teenage girls need innerwear that fits a changing body, and mothers want brands they trust. Content that explains sizing and first bras gently builds loyalty. Schools, mothers' communities and paediatric creators are good channels. Repeat purchases are frequent as girls grow.
